## Safety-policy violations

No hard safety-policy violations detected.

## Interpretation

WER is calculated from the preserved free transcript. Reading-event metrics are calculated from adjudicated token events. Approved regional variants remain in the false-correction denominator and should resolve to STAY SILENT. Low-confidence or unstable evidence is counted as abstention rather than a reading error.
